_meta.source: THE source of truth for BBS vendor facts on California bid forms. Every form skill in this plugin reads this file and nothing else. Resolve it as ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/references/vendor_profile.json; fill_obs_packet.py derives its flat view from here rather than keeping a second copy.
_meta.do_not_duplicate: If you are about to write a BBS address, cert number, FEIN or signer into a skill, stop and read it from here instead. This file exists because those facts were previously written down twice, in two shapes, and a cert expiry could go stale in one of them while a rep submitted binding bids from the other.
notes: CERT DISCIPLINE — statewide credit comes ONLY from OSDS 2009473. San Diego SLBE 17BB1659 and LA County DVBE 10086 are LOCAL certifications and earn no state credit; never cite them for a statewide bid.

NO SB PREFERENCE IN CALIFORNIA — do not claim it. OSDS 2009473 carries DVBE ONLY. BBS exceeded California's SB revenue threshold and is NOT a California small business, so the 5% Small Business preference (SCM §1204) is NEVER claimed on any California solicitation. Claiming it on a bid signed under penalty of perjury is a false certification. The DVBE incentive (SCM §1202) is unaffected and IS claimed on every California competitive solicitation, informal ones included — never on an LPA/NASPO order, a federal bid, or storefront copy. SEPARATELY AND STILL TRUE: federally BBS IS a small business (SBA size standards are far higher than California's) as well as SDVOSB — never strip a federal small-business claim on the strength of this note. Ruling: Parker, in session, 2026-09-22; supersedes the 2026-09-02 reversal. Reasoning and provenance live in bbs-foundations canonical-facts.md, "Small-business status is channel-dependent" — this note cites it, it does not restate it.
In FEDERAL context BBS is SDVOSB, not DVBE. DVBE is the California term. Do not mix them on one form.
A manufacturer's own GSA or contract vehicle does not authorize BBS to fulfill unless BBS is a named reseller.

SIGNATURE IMAGES — `signature_image` on each person in authorized_representatives is the one place a signature PNG's location is written; only the signature_delegation roles carry one (Parker on sales_manager, Jackson on dvbe_owner). The PNGs live in OneDrive/SharePoint and are never committed (credentials stay out of git). `MASTER/` is the synced `Black Box Safety - MASTER` library folder — the one scripts/bbs-workspaces.py find_onedrive_master() finds; on a Teams-site sync its name carries a '… - ' prefix. Pass the path unchanged in fill_ca_forms.py's `signatures` map with that folder as `master_root`; the script joins it and stops if the file is missing or not a PNG. Parker's path was corrected 2026-09-28 after the Sentinel folder rename to `vandenberg-sentinel-rfps` (Sep 2026); Jackson's was verified present by the steward the same day.
FEIN and seller's permit live here deliberately. This repo is BBS-specific and private; the canonical-facts rule against committing them guards work that might be reused elsewhere.

sb_dvbe.scope: California statewide — DVBE only. BBS is not a California small business (state SB revenue threshold exceeded); see _meta.notes.
sb_dvbe.key_name_note: The key is still `sb_dvbe` because skills and fill_obs_packet.py resolve it by that name; the name is historical and does NOT mean the cert carries SB. Read `carries`.
